pages.text: [#](53341a)Eleven chapters lie ahead of this one, pupil, and they open in their proper order — craft a subject's book and its pages appear here. Beyond this **Getting Started** road of the altar, the boline, and the first roots, the whole path runs:[#]()
pages.title: Path of the Craft

pages.text:
1. [#](53341a)**Collecting Fumes** — the Witches' Oven.[#]()
2. [#](53341a)**Herbology** — Mutandis and the Cauldron.[#]()
3. [#](53341a)**Brews & Infusions** — the Kettle.[#]()
4. [#](53341a)**Distilling** — essences drawn by heat.[#]()
5. [#](53341a)**Circle Magic** — chalk and rites.[#]()
6. [#](53341a)**Conjuration** — the Brazier.[#]()
7. [#](53341a)**Symbology** — the Mystic Branch.[#]()
8. [#](53341a)**Poppets** — binding from afar.[#]()
9. [#](53341a)**The Spirit World** — dreams and the dead.[#]()
10. [#](53341a)**Creatures** — familiars and beasts.[#]()
11. [#](53341a)**Transformations** — the wolf and the night.[#]()
[#](53341a)The order is a teacher's order, not a cage. Should a coven witch or a dusty bookshop press a later chapter into your hands early, read it gladly — knowledge found is knowledge still.[#]()
